dataset_name: IMD High-Resolution Daily Gridded & Station Rainfall
source_agency: India Meteorological Department (IMD), Ministry of Earth Sciences, Govt of India
spatial_resolution: 0.25 degree x 0.25 degree (~27 km) or AWS point station coordinates
license_or_access_notes: Open Government Data (OGD) Platform India / IMD National Data Centre terms of access. Research use permitted with citation.
notes: Standard Indian daily meteorological observation window runs 08:30 IST to 08:30 IST (+05:30 UTC). Heavy or extreme precipitation is flagged above 64.5 mm (Heavy), 115.5 mm (Very Heavy), and 204.4 mm (Extremely Heavy).
